frames.narration: A checkout starts a new unit of work. Nothing is written yet.
The checkout registers three changes. The unit only remembers them.
The store still holds the old state. The checkout can still be abandoned for free.
commit() takes a snapshot, then writes the three changes in one transaction.
The third write is rejected. The unit restores the snapshot, so none of the three stay.
Without a failure, all three are saved and the unit is thrown away.
